message: COPY RTNCODE (67) and COPY ERRHAND (68) sit directly under WORKING-STORAGE (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0076-SEC-0004) with no enclosing 01; EXPANDS_COPY is held by the section. Their bytes count only in the copybooks' own records, not in this file's total_bytes.
FILLER PIC X(72) at line 101 has its VALUE clause on line 102 (Area B, not a column-7 continuation); the entry spans lines 101-102 and the literal 'TEST VALIDATION REPORT' is recorded as written.
